title.narrative: Supporting Morocco's preparedness for utilizing cooperative approaches under Article 6 of the PA

description.narrative: The aim is to establish a partnership with GIZ in order to assist Morocco in its preparations for utilizing cooperative approaches as outlined in Article 6 of the Paris Agreement.

The aim of the project is to enable Morocco to access international climate financing through its participation in cooperative approaches as outlined in Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement. This will be achieved by establishing a strong and transparent internal governance system. Key components include a clear institutional and regulatory framework, reliable monitoring systems, and training for stakeholders, all designed to ensure environmental integrity and alignment with Morocco's national climate objectives.
